source: Frozen EA paper reference with separately implemented verified numerical runtime
adapter: four_modes.py selects four CV/CTRV hypotheses and calls verified_calculator.py and verified_solver.py; the four original reference modules remain unmodified

runtime_policy.candidate_acceptance: SAT collision-free check on the effective fine grid before returning a finite candidate
runtime_policy.local_refinement: All local directions use the effective fine grid; no unverified coarse-value fallback
runtime_policy.current_contact: Current OBB contact or overlap is conservatively reported as positive infinity
runtime_policy.fine_refine_ratio: Accepted for API compatibility; not used to skip fine verification
runtime_policy.historical_numerical_identity: Not asserted; differences from the frozen reference are measured explicitly

aggregation: arithmetic mean of raw CV-CV, CV-CTRV, CTRV-CV, CTRV-CTRV values; no rounding in the public API
